programme.title: Clive Myrie's Caribbean Adventure
programme.desc: The Platinum Coast of Barbados is known for its golden sands and wealthy inhabitants. Clive is more interested in why this tiny country produces so many international cricketers and meets one of the island's top coaches for a few tips on his batting. He also joins in with a local tradition of a morning swim with Barbados' top racehorses and trainers before jumping on a boat to land an enormous Caribbean catch for a classic Bajan cookout.

8 ½ Women
programme.desc: Following the death of a mother, a father and son open up their very own harem in their Genevan estate after watching Federico Fellini's 1963 film '8½'.

programme.title: The Lookout
programme.desc: Daniel Auteuil, Mathieu Kassovitz and Olivier Gourmet star in this French crime drama, in which director Michele Placido spins a swiftly moving, complex tale of intrigue and murderous deception. Parisian chief inspector Mattei (Auteuil) believes his carefully prepared sting will finally net a band of persistent bank robbers. But, just as the police operation is reaching its climax, an unseen sniper starts to pick off Mattei's men and, in the blood-drenched confusion, the thieves escape with their loot. Emerging from the carnage, Mattei vows revenge and soon has the suspected killer, Vincent (Kassovitz), in custody. But as his investigation develops further, it becomes clear that it won't be easy to pin the crime on the young man; and he still needs to track down the rest of the gang. Meanwhile, holed-up in the countryside with a doctor (Gourmet) who has been hired to patch them up, the criminals begin to realise that they're far from safe - and it's not the police that they most have to worry about. In French with English subtitles. Film4 premiere.

programme.title: The Butler
programme.desc: The Butler (2013) is an American historical drama directed by Lee Daniels and starring Forest Whitaker and Oprah Winfrey. At the White House an elderly butler named Cecil Gaines is waiting for the newly inaugurated president Barack Obama. While waiting, the butler recounts his life story and all the former US presidents he served. A butler's job requires keeping what you heard to yourself and doing your job unnoticed. Serving eight presidents during his tenure, Cecil observed how American society was changing and even he has felt these changes.

programme.title: Horrid Henry: The Movie
programme.desc: Comedy based on the animated series about the fictional anti-hero, starring Angelica Huston, Richard E Grant, Parminder Nagra and Rebecca Front. When a group of corrupt school inspectors plan to close Henry's school, Ashton Primary, the headmaster of the neighbouring school sees his opportunity to make a fortune from the influx of new pupils, Henry puts together a talent contest, hoping that the success of his Zero Zombies Band will mean that no one will dare close Aston Primary. Miss Oddbot is not impressed and tells Henry that he should have thought about the future of the school before he started being horrid. Meanwhile, evil headmaster Van Winkle holds Miss Lovely, Perfect Peter and their friends hostage in his office. Thanks to Henry, Miss Oddbot realises what he is up to, and as the police arrive Henry is the hero - having managed to save the school he always claimed to hate?.

programme.title: Discount
programme.desc: In a gloomy northern suburb where everyone wears a perpetual frown, one of the only major employers in the area seems to be Discount, a medium-sized, low-cost market that attracts crowds of working-class shoppers every morning. Managed with an iron first by the stressed, perpetually single Sofia, the cashiers Gilles, Christiane, Emma and Alfred fight to keep their jobs despite the constant threat of layoffs and the store's draconian rules regarding customer service and bathroom breaks, which are timed with a stopwatch. When Sofia is forced by her own horrible bosses to start issuing pink slips, Gilles convinces his fellow employees to fight back in a completely unexpected manner: stealing boxes of product from Discount and reselling them for even less in a makeshift shop that they open in Christiane's garage.

programme.title: Louise Violet
programme.desc: France. End of the 19th century. Louise Violet, a Parisian teacher, is sent on a mission to the French countryside. She has to impose the free, compulsory and secular school of the Republic.

programme.title: The Green Perfume
programme.desc: Crime - Comedy, Premiere. After witnessing a murder on stage, an actor is drawn into a thrilling investigation across Europe, uncovering secrets and hidden conspiracies that challenge his perception of reality. (Sandrine Kiberlain, Arieh Worthalter) 2022, 101'

programme.title: The Elephant Man
programme.desc: Moving drama based on the life of John Merrick, a man born with a disfiguring disease who seemed doomed to a grim existence as a sideshow freak until taken in by a London surgeon and introduced to society. Despite his dreadful experiences, Merrick is a gentle, intelligent soul and becomes a popular guest in Victorian drawing rooms - but only if his deformed features are completely covered.

programme.title: Days of the Bagnold Summer
programme.desc: Coming-of-age comedy starring Earl Cave (son of singer Nick) as a heavy-metal-loving teenager who is forced to spend the summer with his boring old mum, in Simon Bird's (The Inbetweeners) debut feature in the director's chair. Daniel (Cave) is all set for six weeks in Florida with his dad and his dad's pregnant wife, Bernie. The weather will be fantastic, and he'll get to drive his father's MG convertible. Meanwhile, his mum (Monica Dolan) won't let him drive the Vauxhall Astra and she never gets her own cake, but instead nicks bits of his. So, when Bernie calls to say that Daniel won't be able to come to Florida, Daniel is obviously not very happy. Can a Metallica-loving, black-clad teenager with Tippexed emblems on his shoes have any fun with a middle-aged librarian who wears comfortable sandals? Well, she is his mum... Also starring Tamsin Greig and Rob Brydon. Network Premiere.

programme.title: Swallows and Amazons
programme.desc: Four children dream of escaping the tedium of a summer holiday with their mother. When finally given permission to camp on their own on an island in the middle of a vast lake in the Lake District, they are overjoyed. But when they get there they discover they may not be alone. The battle for ownership of a lonely island teaches them the skills of survival, the value of friendship and the importance of holding your nerve. Based on the novel by Arthur Ransome.

programme.title: Raining Stones
programme.desc: Ken Loach's Cannes Jury Prize-winning drama is a touching observation of Catholic couple Bob (Bruce Jones) and Anne (Julie Brown) as they try to find the money for their daughter's communion dress. Ducker and diver Bob soon finds himself in trouble with the local loan sharks and the opening humour of the film begins to develop a darker side. Also starring Ricky Tomlinson.

programme.title: The Wall of Mexico
programme.desc: A wealthy Mexican-American family decides to build a wall around their ranch to stop townspeople from stealing their well water, which is rumored to have unusual properties.

programme.title: Year Of the Fox
programme.desc: Ivy is a teenager navigating Aspen's party scene amidst her adoptive parents' divorce. As she watches her community provide cover for predatory behavior, Ivy struggles to find her path.

programme.desc: Drunk, Archie sends a valentine to his best friend's wife. She sends one to her husband. He hides it so she disguises herself as a slut. Will he cheat on his wife - with his wife? Let us see what happens.

programme.title: Tanked
programme.desc: Follow aquarium enthusiasts Brett Raymer and Wayde King as they attempt to build some of the most luxurious fish tanks in the world. At Acrylic Tank Manufacturing, the brothers-in-law guide you through the design process and the building of their truly jaw-dropping aquariums. Experience the unveiling of finished tanks housed everywhere from restaurants and banks, to glamorous casinos and mansions. Join the duo in their Las Vegas workshop as they deliver some budget-shattering builds to their high-profile clientele.

programme.title: Animal Cops: Philadelphia
programme.desc: Animal Cops: Philadelphia follows the work of the Pennsylvania SPCA's Humane Law Enforcement team as they investigate cases of animal cruelty; rescue sick and abused animals and fight for justice on their behalf. The Pennsylvania SPCA's humane law enforcement officers cover an area of over 46,000 square miles from their headquarters in Philadelphia. The six offic ers with full police powers and six agent trainees are on call 24 hours a day seven days a week protecting the city's one and a half million pets.

programme.title: Edge of Alaska
programme.desc: Hidden deep in the wilderness of eastern Alaska and built during the Gold Rush as Alaska's original 'Sin City', only 42 residents currently brave the extreme conditions in McCarthy. It's an isolated outlaw town - a refuge for people who don't want to be found that's surrounded by extreme wilderness over 100 miles from the authorities where young men go to prove themselves and old outlaws go to die; hunters, gold miners, gunsmiths, and survivalists who reside in this 'Old West' town are willing to risk their lives to live truly free. While some believe in continuing the town's frontier way of life, others feel the future of McCarthy depends on dragging itself into the modern age. Which way of life will reign supreme?

programme.title: Jeremy Wade's Dark Waters
programme.desc: Join biologist and angling expert Jeremy Wade as he travels the world peering through our darkest, murky waters, investigating tales of mythical monsters, mutated beasts and depleting fish populations. The star of River Monsters is back to explain the unexplainable, as he investigates these reported sightings of unknown creatures. Whether it's Lake Garda's reptilian monster, a species of pike the size of a man, a river monster deemed extinct in the Outback or South Africa's fabled half-man, half-fish monster, Jeremy will need to use all of his experience if he is to catch, or even glimpse, these creatures.

programme.title: My Cat from Hell
programme.desc: Jackson Galaxy is a cat behaviorist. He is the person who resolves conflicts or behavioral issues between the owners and their cats or even between the cats and other pets. These are attacks and misbehavior, and Jackson is a true cat-lover and a believer that any problem can be solved thanks to love, patience and proper handling. Taking good care of cats is a demanding process and a whole science, but in return you will get a loving and purring family member.

programme.title: Pit Bulls & Parolees
programme.desc: Pit bulls are eager to please, faithful and enthusiastic friends and pleasant with children according to credible canine organizations. But they have fallen from grace. Now often associated with gang members, dog fighting and attacks. That's about to change. Animal Planet introduces you to this dog's greatest ally, and she's not a man - she's a fiery red-headed leading lady, and she's determined to end the needless hostility toward pit bulls. Meet Tia Maria Torres - 49-year-old mother, top pit bull trainer and founder and owner of Villalobos Rescue Center - the country's largest rescue facility for pit bulls.

programme.desc: Wildlife biologist and animal tracker, Forrest Galante, sets out on the Indian Ocean to search for the Pondicherry shark-believed to be extinct since the 1970s. The rare species' alleged extinction has been recently questions, due to recent photos appearing of unidentified sharks around Sri Lanka and the Maldives. Could the Pondicherry shark still be alive? If Galante can prove it's still alive, it will be removed off the extinct species list. Extinct or Alive.

programme.desc: This reality TV show follows Marty Raney and his two children, Matt Raney and Misty Bilodeau, who are successful homesteaders from the state of Alaska and have the skills needed to fish, hunt, raise livestock, and otherwise survive in an untamed landscape. Struggling homesteaders across the country call these experts to help them save their homesteads and become self-sufficient while they teach them the necessary skills to survive the wilderness.

Even when the odds are stacked the staff is dedicated to help the penguins get back on their feet. Meet the adorable characters of the penguins, each with a story of their own and a distinct personality.

Each round has a time limit. The dishes are judged based on their presentation, taste and creativity. At the end of every round one chef is "chopped" from the competition with no prize. The winner can get up to $50.000.

programme.title: Restaurant: Impossible
programme.desc: After combating countless "impossible dinners," Chef Robert Irvine faces a daunting new challenge: save America's most desperate restaurants from impending failure in just two days with only $10,000. In his new prime-time Food Network series, Restaurant: Impossible, Robert uses creativity and resourcefulness along with a lot of muscle in his fight to rescue these restaurants and give hope to the owners and their employees. Day one of the extreme mission begins with a thorough business assessment as Robert launches the restaurant into full service, closely observes the staff and kitchen, and determines their weakest spots. Then, he springs into action by updating the menu, retraining the staff and implementing aesthetic changes with the help of his design team. To ensure a packed house for the grand re-opening at the end of day two, Robert hits the streets to tell the community about the improved restaurant. Will the ruthless schedule, tight budget and ambitious task overcome Robert's lofty goals, or will this tall order result in restaurant triumph?

Each show has a specific focus on a certain dish, like burgers, pasta, comfort food. Small cafes with traditional food and home-style recipes or ethnic specialties adored by the locals are of particular interest to the host. Guy Fieri enters the kitchen, gets to know the cook, actively takes part in cooking, interacts with the guests and kitchen staff and gives his humorous spicy comments on the process and the food itself.

The series explores them and presents the uncovered and deciphered of a mysterious real world. Did President Roosevelt know about Pearl Harbor? programme.title: Cooper's Treasure
programme.desc: Considered one of NASA's original space pioneers, astronaut Gordon Cooper discovered something extraordinary on a 1963 mission. While circling Earth during a 122-hour flight to detect nuclear sites, Cooper photographed more than 100 anomalies around the South Caribbean. He later believed the dark patches that appeared on the photos to be sunken ships, and while working for decades in secret, Gordon created a map that he thought could uncover treasures worth billions of dollars. Before passing away, he shared his meticulous research with longtime friend Darrell Miklos, and now Miklos is teaming with seasoned explorers and researchers to finally make good on Gordon's dream.

programme.title: Alaska Monsters
programme.desc: Within the Last Frontier lies a region known as the Alaska Triangle, spanning 200,000 unforgiving square miles where more people go missing per capita than anywhere else on earth. Treacherous terrain and unforgiving natural elements have stopped many in their tracks, but some Alaskans hold onto the idea that mysterious monsters snatched them up. Unidentified crypto-creatures wander the state covered by millions of acres of dense wilderness and are known to lift and reposition trees with ease, create seismic activity with their minds, and even decapitate humans with one bite. Destination America's new series ALASKA MONSTERS travels with a team of native outdoorsmen, who call themselves the Midnight Sons, as they investigate the harsh Alaskan forest in a quest to uncover proof of frightening monsters thought to be living there.

programme.desc: Paranormal documentary and reality TV series follows investigations of scary locations reported to be haunted by ghost hunters Zak Bagans, Nick Groff, and Aaron Goodwin. Many places with shady past like hotels, casinos, homes, abandoned buildings are full of aggressive paranormal activities and do not let people live peacefully. Each episode begins with the crew touring the investigation site with its owners and interviewing the witnesses. Then the ghost hunters crew set up static night-vision cameras to film what's happening. They use a lot of up-to-date equipment to get any sort of evidence and then based on what they manage to get, they start analyzing and investigating things in order to get to the core of each case.

programme.title: The Holzer Files
programme.desc: Based on the real life files of America's first ghost hunter, Dr. Hans Holzer (whose most famous case concerned the Lutz family of Amityville, NY), this show follows a team of paranormal investigators as they reexamine the terrifying tales that mystified the doctor. The team consists of paranormal investigator Dave Schrader, psychic medium Cindy Kaza and equipment technician Shane Pittman and they are aided by Holzer's daughter, Alexandra. They examine thousands of documents, letters, photographs, and audio and visual recordings, sometimes going as far back as the 50s. Following on from where Holzer left off, the team bring the investigations up to the present day and visit the locations of the supernatural events such as the Peck House, the Morris-Jumel Mansion, the Whaley House, and the USS Constellation.

programme.title: People Magazine Investigates
programme.desc: Investigation Discovery and People magazine partner to re-examine some of the most high profile crime cases in recent history. The one-hour series brings viewers tales of betrayal, buried secrets and unsung heroes, ripped from the pages of one of the nation's top weekly magazines. These stories transcended news and became part of pop culture, revealing shocking twists, new evidence, and unexpected resolutions. Interlaced within every episode are exclusive interviews with People's journalists, archival footage, re-creations, and firsthand accounts by those closest to the investigations.

programme.title: Disappeared
programme.desc: A person suddenly and unexpectedly disappears; no trace, no clues, nothing but the lingering mystery they leave behind. According to the FBI's National Crime Information Center, there are now 110,484 active missing persons cases in the U.S., 53% are juveniles under the age of 18. Most of us have heard of the high-profile cases, such as Natalee Holloway, Stacey Peterson, and Chandra Levy. But have you ever heard of Mae Catherine Rocker, Alexis Peterson or Thomas Jay Kerr? Probably not. They are just a few of the hundreds of thousands of people in this country who one day, simply Disappeared. Most missing person's stories have never been told...until now. Disappeared is an exciting series that investigates the disappearance of these victims, who are here one minute, gone the next. Each episode focuses on one victim's story, as told through the perspectives and actual voices of their closest friends and family and the investigators trying to solve the case. Through interviews with family, friends, police, and searchers, each episode recounts the actions, thoughts, circumstances and motivations that led to each person's disappearance. Experience the victim's final hours until they vanished. Watch interviews with experts, from psychologists to forensic specialists to psychics, who will offer new insights into what may have happened in each case, whether the person was a victim of foul play or a runaway. Disappeared will take you inside the world of the missing, where a person can vanish without a trace, investigators race against the clock to solve a mystery, and the victim's anguished family and friends are left to wonder what in the world could have happened.

programme.title: The Murder Tapes
programme.desc: Beverly Puccio is found murdered in her home, and her ex-boyfriend is pegged as the culprit. He displays odd behavior when the police arrive to investigate, leaving them to question the true identity of her murderer. Bodycam video, original audio, and interrogation room footage show detectives swiftly piecing together the last night of Beverly's life. They track her encounter with a mysterious stranger at a bar, their flirtatious time together, and their cab ride toward her home. Detectives also discover additional clues that lead them to the identity of the mystery man, but conflicting evidence makes it hard to pinpoint the murderer.

programme.title: The Murder Tapes
programme.desc: Michelle Kinney is a free-spirited, trusting and generous mother of two boys in the town of Dubuque, Iowa, who is loved by the entire town. When her battered and bloody body is discovered in her apartment, the community is left numb with shock. Investigators discover that Michelle often took in people who were going through tough times and needed a place to stay for a few nights. This leads them to question if her generous spirit contributed to her death. And what detectives unearth staggers citizens, friends and family alike.

programme.title: The Perfect Murder

The key to their success is their great level of persistence, and imaginative investigative skills. Dead ends won't deter the team, when a seemingly impossible case lands on their desks, they always find a way in the end.

programme.title: American Chopper
programme.desc: American Chopper is an American reality television series that revolves around the Teutuls- Paul Senior, his sons Paul Junior and Michael who work together at Orange County Choppers, a custom motorcycle fabrication company located in Montgomery, New York. The series is a mix of competition and drama, famous for real fighting, cursing, crying, welding, and painting. It's indisputable that each Teutul is a gifted mechanic, engineer and designer, they put together a motorbike in front of the viewers and make every customer's wish come true.

programme.title: Border Control: Turkey
programme.desc: Elite teams battle smugglers at Turkey's land, air, and sea borders in a nonstop fight to protect national security.

programme.title: Inside the Arrest
programme.desc: British police make 2,000 arrests a day, but one bad move can endanger them and jeopardise a whole investigation. Experts analyse footage of the most dramatic arrest footage, revealing the detailed planning that goes into each operation.

programme.title: Wheeler Dealers
programme.desc: Buy, repair and restore and then resell a classic car in order to make profit- this is what Wheeler Dealers is about. The budget is limited, though you can see some exclusive and rare cars. Mike Brewer, a British dealer chooses the car carefully and hands it over to the mechanic, first Edd China, later Ant Anstead to be fixed and upgraded. The hosts are real masters of their trade, it seems they can bring life even to a piece of metal. It does not matter if you are a life-long car enthusiast or do not even have a driving license you will admire the results of hard work from the beginning to the end of the long uneasy restoring process.

programme.title: Salvage Hunters
programme.desc: Drew Pritchard is a modern-day treasure hunter searching the back roads of the UK to discover hidden riches. With demanding customers, high turnover and one of the biggest decorative salvage yards in the UK, Drew is constantly on the road, crisscrossing the country in search of derelict gems and forgotten remnants. Drew loves the thrill of the hunt and while he gets his hands dirty in the country's architectural backwaters, his crack team of restorers is back at the shop giving old and rare finds a new lease on life. Follow Drew and his crack team of specialists on a fascinating journey through the entire picking process – from the initial expedition, to renewal, and finally to resale. Showcasing his hard-earned knowledge and appreciation of salvage and restoration, each episode accompanies Drew on one big buying venture, such as setting off with an empty van and returning with a 20th century stained glass Gothic doorway from an Irish monastery – as well as the small, unpredictable adventures along the way. Simply discovering a treasure is only half the battle, as Drew must artfully convince owners to sell, and at his price. After a successful purchase, Drew and his team of experts bring the items back to Fabulously British Salvage, his tremendous 20,000 square foot showroom located in North Wales, to restore them to their original brilliance, before reselling them for profit. This is not an easy business, as any trip can feature the next great find or a bust that costs Drew and his team thousands. However, Drew's keen eye and adroit negotiating skills are second to none – his passion and drive for success make him one of the best in the business.

programme.title: How It's Made
programme.desc: Have you ever wondered how things that surround us every day are produced? Find out about the whole process from the beginning to the end in a documentary television series How It's Made. The series demonstrates how various items like clothing and accessories, food, industrial products, cars, musical instruments and many more are manufactured. Who would have thought how exciting it would be to watch a cupcake, formula 1 race car or gummy vitamins being made?

programme.title: Mega Shippers
programme.desc: Documentary series that follows the work of some of the world's biggest and most highly-skilled shippers, who are responsible for keeping the world's cargo ships on the move 365 days a year. There are at least 20 million shipping containers crossing the world's seas at any given time as 90% of world trade is transported by water and, as mega ships now dominate global waters, big money is at stake. From shipping tens of thousands of luxury cars, multi-million dollar yachts, to a 20 ton shipment of sweet potatoes, the audience will have a chance to see ground crews use precision engineering, top-of-the-line machinery, and nerves of steel to on-load and off-load these precious, but very different cargoes, conquering various on-the-spot challenges from miscalculations to malfunctions.

programme.title: Scrappers
programme.desc: Trading scrap metal is like playing the stock market. From a small collection point, scrap metal goes a long way to collect and segregate before it reaches the furnace. The steel mills order batches of appropriately selected and prepared raw materials in a specified quantity and time. To trade scrap metal, you must have the ability to do business as well as luck. This program invites you to meet people who work in scrap yards all over Poland.

programme.title: Unexpected: Teenage & Pregnant
programme.desc: This programme aims to explore the complicated issues that can happen when teenage pregnancy suddenly happens. Focusing on three girls, the camera captures each trimester and the first few weeks of parenthood. Each couple is completely unprepared for what is about to happen when they become parents which is where each set of grandparents comes in handy. Tensions become high as everyone has their own set of rules on what the "perfect" parent should be like and what the future beholds for the young parents to be.

programme.title: Match Me Abroad
programme.desc: After failing to find a soulmate in the US, Americans take the search overseas for a chance at happiness. Expert matchmakers pull out all the stops to connect these hopeful romantics to their one true love.

programme.title: 7 Little Johnstons
programme.desc: Amber and Trent Johnston are living the American dream. They have been happily married for 14 years and have five children ranging from 6 to 13 years old. On paper, they might seem like your average family...yet in person, they attract a lot of attention.... because all seven members of the Johnston family – Amber, Trent, their two biological children, Jonah and Elizabeth, as well as their three adopted children, Anna, Emma and Alex – happen to have Achondroplasia Dwarfism. Together, these spunky seven make up the largest known family of Achondroplastic dwarfs in the world, and even describe themselves as "the real life seven dwarfs."

programme.title: Sweet Home Sextuplets
programme.desc: Courtney and Eric Waldrop, their three older boys and sextuplet babies are a tight-knit family living on a sheep farm in small town Alabama. Their strong desire for one more baby resulted in the biggest possible surprise- sextuplets. Have a close look at this adorable family and all of its members starting from the days when there were "just" five of them. Risky pregnancy, premature birth, arriving home, taking care of six babies, managing the whole family and adjusting to the new pace of life- all of this and much more are there for the viewers.

programme.title: Say Yes to the Dress With Gok

Of course, the final decision lies with the bride, and they must say yes to the dress before they can flaunt it down the aisle.

programme.title: Kitchen Boss

programme.title: Dr. Pimple Popper
programme.desc: Definitely not created for the squeamish, Dr Pimple Popper features dermatologist and Internet celebrity Dr. Sandra Lee as she treats patients suffering with unique skin conditions such as facial and skin disorders. Including the extraction of blackheads, cysts and uncovering new skin conditions that audiences may not have known of before, Dr. Sandra Lee started uploading content onto Youtube and Instagram, gaining a lot of popularity by people enjoying spots and cysts being popped. Those included within her videos gave written permission for her to record and post the content in exchange for discounted or free-treatments. Dr. Pimple Popper is on a mission to reclaim the lives of those suffering with these unusual and rare skin condition and remove their embarrassment.

programme.title: Body Bizarre
programme.desc: Criss-crossing the globe, 'Body Bizarre' embarks on a voyage of discovery unlike any other. From India's child snake charmers to the world's hairiest girl, this series uncovers the real human stories behind the headlines. With deeply personal interviews and footage from the most unusual of day-to-day routines, it's an adventure through the truly astonishing. Six-year-old Liu Jiangli was abandoned by her parents as a two-year-old after being born with large black spots and fur on her face and body. Connie Culp became the first American to undergo a face transplant in 2008, after being shot in the face by her ex-husband. These stories, and others, explore what life is like for some of the world's most extraordinary individuals.

programme.title: Seconds from Disaster
programme.desc: Excitement and anticipation surrounds the 1986 Space Shuttle Challenger launch from Kennedy Space Center in Florida, U.S. This momentous endeavour would mark the first time that any civilian has been flown into space. On 28 January, 1986, school children and others watch eagerly on the ground and on television, as school teacher Christa McAuliffe prepares to become the first civilian to join the astronauts. At 11:38 AM, Space Shuttle Challenger lifts off, barrelling towards the atmosphere. However, a mere 73 seconds later, onlookers and the nation watch in horror when the shuttle is suddenly engulfed in flames and breaks apart in the sky. A full-scale enquiry of the crash is launched with NASA officials searching for clues to the shuttle's explosion, desperate to answer the most agonizing question: could this tragedy have been prevented?

programme.title: Lawless Island
programme.desc: The volatile climate of Southeast Alaska challenges Port Protection's residents who live on the edge of society. Gary battles father time while securing needed resources. Curly pushes through in the wake of a tragic loss. Mary faces her fears to survive in extreme conditions. Sam fights to preserve the only lifestyle he's ever known. Squibb looks to improve upon his surroundings. And Stuart deals with past injuries as he battles the elements.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: A loud vibration and the smell of smoke warn the pilots of British Midland Flight 92 that they have an engine fire on board. The crew shuts down the engine and tries to land at a nearby airport, but their second engine fails before they can get safely on the ground. Just meters from the runway, the 737-400 slams into an embankment beside Britain's busy M1 motorway. It seems like a rare case of dual engine failure, but investigators soon learn that a tragic misunderstanding may be the real cause of the crash.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Harrowing stories of tragedy and triumph are brought to life through official reports, transcripts and interviews with the pilots, air traffic controllers and lucky survivors of history's most terrifying crashes. Widely considered to be the safest form of travel, air transportation is still in its infancy and when midair calamity strikes, the results are often catastrophic. From the cockpit to the cabin, from the control room to the crash scene, we uncover just what went wrong.

programme.title: Science of Stupid
programme.desc: Science of Stupid, series 8. Dallas Campbell hosts the show that combines serious science with some of the craziest, most spectacular user generated clips ever recorded. In each programme we show 40 to 50 clips of misadventure: ordinary folk making extraordinary mistakes and paying the price. We analyse the science behind the mishaps, with the help of bespoke animation and super slow-motion cinematography.

programme.title: Car S.O.S.
programme.desc: Car SOS is back for a sixth series with parts blagging petrolhead Tim Shaw and master mechanic Fuzz Townshend breathing life into classic cars for unsuspecting owners. This series yet another array of iconic cars including a 1990s Lancia Delta Integrale, a 60s Citroen DS, an 80s Peugeot 205 Rally car and a 1950s MGA. Special guests this series include actor James Nesbitt and Monte Carlo legend Paddy Hopkirk.

programme.title: Car S.O.S.
programme.desc: Tim and Fuzz take on the restoration of a lightweight British pocket rocket , a 1997 Lotus Elise. The car's owner, 44 year old former print manager Sarah, had been planning to get the car back on the road with the help of her dad Phil until double tragedy struck - he fell victim to incurable bowel cancer then sadly Sarah herself was also diagnosed with cancer. The car's restoration was put on hold. Mother Jenny wrote in to Car SOS hoping to bring back her daughter's much needed smile.

programme.title: Car S.O.S.
programme.desc: Tim and Fuzz have travelled to Milton Keynes to try and rescue Craig's 1930 Ford Model A, an historic car with an impressive pedigree. The car's owner is 58 year old former electrician Craig a dyed in the wool classic car lover. He's had his Model A for over 30 years, however after a tragic motor cycle accident any plans for restoration evaporated when his whole world was turned upside down. Once the car hits the Car SOS workshop its wooden coachwork and 90 year old parts prove a big challenge for the team.

programme.title: Car S.O.S.
programme.desc: Tim and Fuzz have taken on a 1972 Peugeot 504 cabriolet - a rare French grand tourer that is considered by many to be the most beautifully designed car that Peugeot ever produced. The car belongs to former NHS dentist Barry who bought it back in the 1980s . He had planned to restore his much loved motor back to its former glory but when family issues and ill health got in the way his Peugeot dream came to an end. His family put in a call to Car SOS hoping that Tim and Fuzz could help say a big thank you to this pillar of the local community.

programme.title: Engineering Europe: Compilations
programme.desc: Across Europe, visionary engineers are redefining what it means to live in harmony with the planet's environment. Discover Iceland's colossal lava barriers, engineered to shield the Blue Lagoon and geothermal power plants from volcanoes. Witness the rise of Stockholm's "Wood City," an innovative timber metropolis setting new standards for sustainable urban living, and the breathtaking Setas de Sevilla, a large wooden structure that revitalizes the city center. Explore Germany's groundbreaking surf park, the UK's futuristic Eden Project, and enduring wooden marvels like the famous windmills in the Netherlands. From eco-friendly megaprojects to centuries-old ingenuity, European engineers blend tradition and technology to restore, protect and transform the continent for generations to come.

programme.title: Engineering Europe: Compilations
programme.desc: Underground, over mountains and across water, Europe's landscapes demand all forms of transportation to connect its citizens. The iconic 139-year-old Tower Bridge in London, which sees thousands of commuters every day, must be ready at a given moment to stop traffic and let boats through. The lesser-known Galecopperbrug in Utrecht, Netherlands, needs to undergo a major renovation to support its steel cables. Meanwhile, extensive and innovative renovations in the middle of Amsterdam will revolutionize rail and bike traffic, while a high-speed railway in the mountainous Basque Country of Spain will create a network that connects commuters to major cities. Engineers need to be cunning, innovative and flexible to keep up with the modern-day demands of European transportation.

programme.title: Engineering Europe: Compilations
programme.desc: Embark on a thrilling journey across Europe to uncover several extraordinary feats of engineering and innovation. Stunning visuals and expert interviews take you from Denmark's Storstrøm Bridge — a symbol of resilience and connectivity — to the enchanting Dutch Castle de Haar and the avant-garde Hotel Marques de Riscal in Rioja, Spain. Experience the complex ingenuity of the Friesen Rail Bridge in Germany, then venture beneath London to reveal how the mighty "Super Sewer" is transforming urban life. Witness the Dutch Delta Works defending millions from the sea and explore the enduring craftsmanship of the Royal Bodewes shipyard. Through stories and conversations with engineers, discover how relentless ingenuity has shaped these iconic landmarks, forever redefining what's possible across Europe.

programme.title: Lost Treasures of the Bible
programme.desc: Noah and the Great Flood is one of the Bible's best-known tales. Now, investigators seek to unravel the story's origins, which may predate the Old Testament. They explore some of the earliest cities in Mesopotamia, use the latest science to examine past climates, decipher clay tablets, and put an ancient blueprint of the Ark to the test. Immersive CGI brings this long-lost story to life.

programme.title: Lost Treasures of the Bible
programme.desc: Exodus and the conquest of the land of Canaan are among the Bible's most famous stories. They tell how the Israelites triumphed, with the help of the Ark of the Covenant. The problem is that there is little archaeological evidence that these tales happened exactly as the Bible describes. Across the Holy Land, archaeologists and investigators dig through the ruins of ancient cities to uncover the real world behind the biblical accounts. Just west of Jerusalem, one team explores a cave tomb to reveal evidence for the origins of the Israelites' enemies, the Philistines. In northern Israel, another team excavates the remains of the Canaanite kingdom's mightiest stronghold and finds mysterious Egyptian artifacts that shed new light on the traditional tale of the Israelites' journey to what the Bible calls the Promised Land.

programme.title: Airport Security: To Catch a Smuggler Latin America Compilation
programme.desc: These carriers are frequent flyers. From Airport Security Colombia and Peru, a Spaniard with cocaine pretends to be shocked. A man going to the DR with cocaine tells officers he has been there before. A man on his second trip claims he was forced. A woman uses someone else's authentic passport to travel. An Indonesian woman carries cocaine and multiple types of currency. A freelance trafficker boasts he has information on a 1000 kilo load.

programme.title: Airport Security: To Catch a Smuggler Latin America Compilation
programme.desc: The oldest and youngest carriers from Airport Security Colombia and Peru. A woman with cocaine and a record. 19-year-old student carries to help his sick mother. A 19-year-old woman claims her aunt tricked her. An old man cannot believe he is carrying, and neither can the relative he calls. An old man from the Marshall Islands may be part of a trend to enlist the elderly as carriers. A young Venezuelan man risks it all due to conditions at home.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Every time a plane crashes, the world takes notice. And so do the experts whose job it is to figure out what happened. Air Crash Investigation uncovers the truth behind the most legendary aviation disasters, and every episode features eyewitness accounts, captivating reenactments, state-of-the-art CGI, and interviews with the investigators who ultimately determined what went wrong. This season on Air Crash Investigation: Conflicting stories emerge after a Swedish cargo plane spirals to the ground; an African airliner crashes in the wilderness and the cause proves too sinister to be believed; and, when a Pakistani passenger jet disappears on approach to Kathmandu, Nepalese investigators must determine how it ended up on a crash course with the Himalayas.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Every time a plane crashes, the world takes notice. And so do the experts whose job it is to figure out what happened. Air Crash Investigation uncovers the truth behind the most legendary aviation disasters, and every episode features eyewitness accounts, captivating reenactments, state-of-the-art CGI, and interviews with the investigators who ultimately determined what went wrong. This season on Air Crash Investigation: Conflicting stories emerge after a Swedish cargo plane spirals to the ground; an African airliner crashes in the wilderness and the cause proves too sinister to be believed; and, when a Pakistani passenger jet disappears on approach to Kathmandu, Nepalese investigators must determine how it ended up on a crash course with the Himalayas.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: December 29, 1972. Eastern Airlines Flight 401 is coming in for a landing in Miami. On the crews instrument panel, one of the three green lights confirming the planes landing gear is down and locked remains unlit. Captain Robert Loft decides to have the auto pilot fly the plane in a holding pattern while he and his crew work to fix the problem. Flying at 2,000 feet all four men in the cockpit focus their attention on the troublesome bulb. None of them notice that the plane is slowly descending to the ground, until its too late. The brand new L-1011 slams into the remote swampland of the Florida Everglades. Miraculously 77 people survive the initial crash. Investigators determine that the plane was mechanically sound, and that its auto pilot was working. So why had the state of the art jetliner fallen from the sky? The clues would lead investigators to a very troubling cause.

programme.title: Petra: Secrets of the Ancient Builders
programme.desc: In southern Jordan lies the spectacular city of Petra. Built over 2,000 years ago, it contains innumerable architectural treasures: colossal buildings carved into cliffs and hundreds of tombs, temples, and baths. Petra was a rich and prosperous city, and yet, it resides in the heart of an inhospitable region. How did the Nabataeans manage to transform this desert area into a luxurious city?

programme.title: Lost Treasures of the Maya Snake Kings
programme.desc: Fascinating documentary series from National Geographic that sheds new light on the mystifying Maya civilisation. With astounding new evidence, scientists, archaeologists and historians have uncovered the complexity and advancement of this Central American civilisation, which lived across southeastern Mexico, Belize, Honduras, El Salvador and Guatemala. These experts have used advanced technology to scour the jungles of Guatemala, discovering approximately 60,000 new structures that reveal the meandering network of infrastructure which connected the Maya people. One of the ruling dynasties of this ancient era were the Snake Kings, who until recently were unknown. These intriguing new discoveries reveal the extent of the Snake Kings power as they even conquered Tikal, the greatest city in Mayan history.

programme.title: Architects of the Ancient World
programme.desc: Throughout human history, architecture has served to showcase power and express meaning. But buildings also keep secrets. By accident, and by design, whole cities were written in invisible ink, kept safe from the prying eyes of outsiders. This program explores why ancient people riddled their most impressive creations with secrets, and how modern scientists are learning to uncover them.

programme.title: Lost Treasures of Egypt
programme.desc: Archeologists in Egypts Valley of the Nobles unwrap the secret lives of people from the ancient past, including a royal nurse, two children and a woman who served the rich and famous. One-hundred miles from the Valley of the Kings, the Valley of the Nobles is a thousand years older and far less-explored. It contains one of the largest enclaves of intact tombs in Egypt. Two teams of archeologists hit the jackpot as they uncover mummies and artifacts no one has seen for 4,000 years!

programme.title: Lost Treasures of Egypt
programme.desc: Meet the bada#$ queens of ancient Egypt as archeologists read between the hieroglyphs to find the true stories of Cleopatra and Hatshepsut. Of all the hidden mysteries of Egypt, the lives of these queens who would be king are among the most compelling. Immensely powerful, they created larger-than-life legends that have withstood the test of time. Now, archeologists seek to uncover their secrets ?such as where Cleopatra is buried. Even after two millennia, a sandstorm of mystery will swirls around her life? and her story lives on.

programme.title: Decoding History's Prophecies
programme.desc: In 16th-century France, astrologer Nostradamus wrote hundreds of cryptic verses implying impossible knowledge of future events, including the French Revolution, the Second World War, the assassination of JFK, and the attacks of Sept. 11, 2001. Who was Nostradamus, and what did he say? In Central Europe, local legends say Houska Castle guards a portal to hell and is the site of dark, storied history. Here, young poet Karel Hynek Macha had a feverish dream of a future that terrified him. In medieval Italy, St. Francis of Assisi was subjected to the world's first case of stigmata, receiving the wounds of the Christian messiah on his hands, feet and torso. Are the stigmata a blessing, a curse, or a traditional blend of legend and truth? Final

programme.title: Decoding History's Prophecies
programme.desc: In early-1900s Russia, Grigori Rasputin, the professed mystical healer, was both admired and disdained. Some believed he had the czar and czarina under a dark spell. The true Rasputin is hard to decipher, but his claims of prophetic powers led to a controversial and tragic role pivotal to Russian history. In China, a scholar found strange markings on ancient bones that unlocked age-old mysteries. The ancient Chinese believed these "oracle bone" markings could contain traces of the future. In Point Pleasant, West Virginia, a mysterious winged creature is sighted moments before a tragic bridge collapse. The creature, dubbed the "Mothman," sparked decades of debate. Is it real, and did it portend impending doom?

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue
programme.desc: "Ice Road Rescue" portrays a group of heroic tow truck rescue workers. When winter hits Norway the transport roads turn into treacherous bobsleigh tracks. Every day the rescuers fight to keep this routes open by rescuing heavy trailers stuck in the mountain terrain. Winter storms, avalanches and lack of daylight through the winter season are just some of the challenges they have to face, working close to the polar circle. Extreme winter conditions that often make them risk their lives. "Ice Road Rescue" shows the ultimate man versus nature.

programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler
programme.desc: Even during a pandemic, smuggling never stops. Whether narco-traffickers try to slip through an airport, seaport or land crossing, vigilant officers are on high-alert to stem the flow of illegal contraband. Using every tool available to them, DHS will stop at nothing to catch a smuggler.

programme.title: Football: LaLiga. Real Betis - Real Madrid
programme.desc: La Liga (The Campeonato Nacional de Liga de Primera División) is the men's top professional football division of the Spanish football league system. It is administered by the National Professional Football League and has 20 contestants, with the three lowest-placed teams at the end of each season relegated to the Segunda División and replaced by the top two teams and a play-off winner in that division. Nine teams have become champions, Real Madrid has got the title 33 times and FC Barcelona 26 times. La Liga is one of the most popular professional sports leagues in the world and the top league in Europe over the last five years.

programme.title: Korvpall: EuroLeague. Playoffs G2. Olympiacos - AS Monaco
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.desc: Seriaali keskmes on Tallinnas elav perekond - noor naine, tema keskealine mees ja nende väike poeg. Sarja intriigide käivitajaks on mehe eelmine perekond. Põnevust lisavad ka naabrid, sugulased ja tuttavad. Tegevus toimub tänapäeva Eestis ning sarjas, nii nagu ka päris elus, on armastust ja vihkamist, pettumust, leppimist, armukadedust ning huumorit. Sarja peaosatäitjateks on näitlejad Eesti erinevatest teatritest. Martin Veinmann kehastab sarjas pereisa Hannest, tema noort naist Helenit mängib Kleer Maibaum, perepea esimest naist Epp Eespäev ning pereisa tütart esimesest abielust kehastab Kadri Adamson

programme.title: TV3 uudised
programme.desc: TV3 uudistetoimetus võtab igal õhtul operatiivselt ja asjatundlikult kokku olulisemad päevasündmused nii Eestist kui ka mujalt maailmast. Kui igatsed uudistesaadet, mis on aktuaalne, täpne, pisut terav, südamlik ning kus saab ka grammikese nalja, siis õige valik on "TV3 uudised". "TV3 uudised" on eetris igal õhtul kell 19.00. Argipäeviti mahub tunniajasesse saatesse põhjalik ülevaade nii Eestist kui välismaalt. Räägime näiliselt keerulistest asjadest selgelt ja arusaadavalt - sest aega on. Uudistesaate juhid on Liina Kanarbik, Marek Lindmaa ja Tarmo Maiberg. Reportaaže otse sündmuskohtadelt toovad teieni Sirje Eesmaa, Allan Muuk, Sven Soiver, Virgo Pärn, Kadri Pikhof, Marie Metsur, Christina Veinberg ja Tiina Laura Kimmel.

Siis aga selgub, et kuna ta oli 20 aastat tagasi anonüümne spermadoonor, on tal nüüd 533 bioloogilist last, kellest 142 nüüdseks 20. eluaastates noort soovivad kohtu kaudu ta nime teada saada. programme.title: Ment
programme.desc: Urmas Viil susib Reinu selja taga jaoskonnas edasi ja Rein kahlustab nüüd oma parimaid sõpru reetmises. Konstaabel Sile tahab hakata eradetektiiviks, et omal käel karjääri teha. Rein avastab, et tema pangakaart tõrgub ja põhjus võib peituda tema koduseinte vahel. Relika saab lõpuks teada, kes on tema lapse isa. Hans-Kristjan teeb nüüd jaoskonnas lisatööd, et ei peaks burgereid müüma, kuid see kokkulepe paneb jaoskonna kuluaarid kihama. Reinu sõbranna, baaridaam Marta, on oma eluga edasi liikunud ja Rein ei saa talle enam südant puistata. Rein peab keerulisel ajal tegema keerulise otsuse: kas minna poliitikasse ja liikuda täiel kiirusel edasi? Või minna üldse jaoskonnast ära, kus teda näiliselt enam ei vajata.

programme.title: Ment
programme.desc: Relika muretseb oma lapse tervise pärast. Salakaval Urmas Viil üritab aga kogu jaoskonda Reinu vastu koondada ja ennast parema juhina näidata. Rein kohtub oma valimiskampaania asjus PR-mehega ja otsustab täie auruga valimistesse sukelduda. Rein hakkab kahtlema oma parimates sõprades ja tundub, et talle on võim pähe löönud. Ta üritab nii jaoskonnas kui kodus ennast jõuliselt kehtestada, see on aga hoopis kasuks tema vaenlastele. Relika ema tahab välja selgitada Relika lapse isa ja tekitab uut segadust.

programme.title: Lagle rännakud
programme.desc: Dokumentaalfilm Eesti ühiskonnategelasest, kunagisest poliitvangist ja väga erilisest naisest Lagle Parekust. Tema rännak algab 1941. aastal ja jõuab välja tänapäeva. Lagle Pareki esimene reis viis teda juba lapseeas koos perega küüditatuna Siberisse ning aastakümneid hiljem poliitvangina Mordva vangilaagrisse. Nendest sündmustest hoolimata ei meenuta Lagle seda aega kui kannatuste rada, vaid pigem kui seiklust. Parek on ideaalne eeskuju mõistmaks, kuidas kõikide raskuste puhul saab jääda inimeseks. See on lugu inimese olemusest ja kirest elada. Sealjuures Lagle ei väsi kordamast oma ema tarkust: "Pole vahet, kus sa elad, peaasi, et sa inimeseks jääd".

programme.title: Alasti ahvatlus Hispaania
programme.desc: Selles saates saavad osalejad võimaluse valida endale kaaslane paljalt füüsilise veetluse põhjal. Vähehaaval paljastatakse neile kuue naise või mehe kehad ning nad saadavad ükshaaval ära neile väliselt kõige vähem ahvatlevad osalejad. Tänases osas valivad endale kaaslast kahe lapse ema Tracy ja 24-aastane müügimees Matthew.

programme.title: Alasti ahvatlus Hispaania
programme.desc: Selles saates saavad osalejad võimaluse valida endale kaaslane paljalt füüsilise veetluse põhjal. Vähehaaval paljastatakse neile kuue naise või mehe kehad ning nad saadavad ükshaaval ära neile füüsiliselt kõige vähem atraktiivsed osalejad. Tänases osas valivad endale kaaslast 23-aastane hooldustöötaja Sapphire ja 32-aastane tarkvarafirmas töötav Kieran.

programme.title: Alasti ahvatlus Hispaania
programme.desc: Selles saates saavad osalejad võimaluse valida endale kaaslane paljalt välise veetluse põhjal. Vähehaaval paljastatakse neile kuue võimaliku kaaslase kehad ning nad saadavad ükshaaval ära neile väliselt kõige vähem ahvatlevad osalejad. Tänases osas valivad endale kaaslast 24-aastane ettekandja Rebecca ja 25-aastane Dan, kes on partneri otsinguil väga valiv.

programme.title: Edith Piafi laulud
programme.desc: Edith Piafi laule esitab Silvi Vrait. Saatejuhid Anne Erm ja Lauri Leesi. Jacques Prevert'i luulet loeb Kersti Kreismann. Solisti saadab Teleraadiokomitee estraadiorkester Tõnis Kõrvitsa juhatusel, klaveril Olav Ehala. Režissöör Toomas Lasmann, toimetaja Ene Leks. 28. aprillil oli Silvi Vraidi 75. sünniaastapäev.

programme.title: ERR.ee uudised
programme.desc: Eesti Rahvusringhäälingu uudised - Eesti ja kogu maailma kõige värskemad uudised.

programme.title: Kito, Maaja ja jutulaegas
programme.desc: Noor teadlane ja tema truu hobune Rubi otsivad legendaarset ussikuningat, kuid see osutub raskeks. Kui nad ta lõpuks leiavad, on ussikuningas juba teadlasele jälile saanud. Kas ussikuningas satub siiski lõksu?

programme.title: Karumõmm Pups
programme.desc: Täna saab Pupsust vapper tolmukütt.

programme.title: Numbriklotsid
programme.desc: "Numbriklotsid" on sari väikelastele, kus õpetatakse laulude ja sõnamängude toel numbreid tundma ning rehkendusi tegema. Matemaatika on tore - õpime koos liitma ja lahutama!

programme.title: Pisikesed olendid
programme.desc: Pisikesed olendid leiavad fotokaamera ning avastavad, et sellega saab naljakaid pilte teha. Sõbrad panevad vahvad kostüümid selga ja läheb pildistamiseks!

programme.title: Okkake ja Nõelake
programme.desc: Okkake ja Nõelake kohtuvad metsvindiga, kes võlub neid oma imelise lauluga. Lind kutsub siilikesi endaga kaasa laulma, kuid sõbrad pelgavad ning vajavad julgustamist. Tarkusetera - kaasalöömiseks on mitmeid erinevaid võimalusi!

programme.title: Hiir Hops
programme.desc: Hops ja tema sõbrad naudivad lasteaia vaheaega ning üritavad nuputada välja plaane, et puhkus ei lõpeks kunagi.

programme.title: Hiir Hops
programme.desc: Lasteaias räägitakse ametitest. Villu isa on arst, Miguel on juuksur ja Maimu õpetaja. Hops on aga väga pettunud, et tema amet on lihtsalt laps olla, ning otsustab leida endale sobiva ameti.

programme.title: Pips ja Popi
programme.desc: Popi luiskab kokku suure vale, kui ta Pipsi tuulelohe ära kaotab.

programme.title: Anna ja sõbrad
programme.desc: Sisene lihtsasse Anna ja sõprade maailma, milles on rõõmu ja entusiasmi, mida lapsepõlv toob. Sarjas "Anna ja sõbrad" on viis lahutamatut sõpra, kes tähistavad sõpruse võimet, kujutlusvõimelist mängu ja tagaaia seikluseid!

programme.title: Tuta asjad
programme.desc: Rebane on kuulnud dinosaurustest ja kardab neid väga. Tuta aga ei pelga dinosauruseid, sest need elasid ammu, kui inimesi ja rebaseid veel polnud ning neil olid nii huvitavad nimed! Laula koos Tutaga laulu erinevatest saurustest!

programme.title: Põrsas Peppa
programme.desc: Peppa on armas ja alati rõõmsameelne põrsaplika, kes elab koos oma väikese venna George'i, Emme Põssa ja Issi Põssaga. Peppale meeldib mängida, end põnevalt riidesse panna, väljas käia ja mudalompides hüpata. Ta seiklused lõpevad alati õnnelikult ja suure naeruga.

programme.title: Sam ja Julia
programme.desc: Sõbrad lähevad omavahel tülli ja Julia ema annab Samile lepituse otsimiseks head nõu.

programme.title: Kosmo
programme.desc: Koer Kosmo on Williamsite pere suur karvane lemmikloom. Tema ja 13-aastane Robi on südamesõbrad, ent ühel päeval juhtub õnnetus - Kosmo jääb auto alla ning saab tõsiselt vigastada. Robil ja tema parimal sõbral, nutikal ratastoolitüdrukul Elisel õnnestub robootikafirmas, kus töötab Robi ema, asendada Kosmo vigastatud organid bioonilistega, ja sel viisil koera elu päästa. Bioonilised kehaosad annavad Kosmole supervõimed, tänu neile võimetele aitab Kosmo Robil ja Elisel lahendada kõiksugu põnevaid saladusi ning tuua päevavalgele kurikaelte salasepitsusi Merisilma linnakeses, kus nad kõik elavad. Sündmustele lisab põnevust asjaolu, et lapsed peavad kiivalt varjama oma koera saladust, sest selle ilmsikstulek võib maksta Robi emale töökoha. Ema Ester on aga ainuke, kes perele leiva lauale toob.

programme.title: Floor paneb reeglid paika!
programme.desc: Kas pole veidi kahtlane, kui ema on valmis ühe pealtnäha täitsa tavalise väikese töö eest lausa kümme eurot välja käima? Floor paneb paika oma viienda reegli.

programme.title: Tuta kontsert
programme.desc: Mis on kontsert ja kuidas seal käituda? Kui sa veel ei tea, siis ära muretse, Tuta ja tema sõber Rebane teevad sulle kontserdist imelise seikluse. Laulame, tantsime ja rõõmustame koos!

programme.title: Tom Gatesi äge maailm
programme.desc: Täna toimub koolis spordipäev, ent Tom unustab spordipüksid koju! Kuidas olukord laheneb?

programme.title: Lammas Shaun
programme.desc: Nutikas lammas Shaun on täiesti püsimatu loom, kes kaasab pidevalt oma kaaslasi kõiksugu sekeldustesse, pöörates kodufarmis kõik pea peale.

programme.title: Röövlitütar Ronja
programme.desc: Vankumatu Loviis käsib röövlitel oma määrdunud kehad lumes ära pesta ning paneb meeste riided pessu. Ronja saab Mattiselt loa taas metsa seiklema minna.

programme.title: Muusikavideod ETV2
programme.desc: ETV laululaste ja Kustas Kikerpuu ansambli esituses aastast 1978 kõlab "Teelemineku laul". Helilooja Arne Oit, sõnad Ellen Niit.

programme.title: Veider Kamp
programme.desc: Olive nakatub kummalisse haigusesse nimega piraatus, mis tähendab, et ta hakkab vaikselt piraadiks muutuma! Otto ja Oscar teevad kõik, et seda peatada. Hiljem muutub aga Oscar diivaniks ning teised agendid peavad leidma lahenduse, et ta jälle endiseks muuta.

programme.title: Jäine planeet II
programme.desc: Maakera põhjaosas asuvad suurimad jäised elukeskkonnad maismaal - suured lumised metsad ja lõputu jäine tundra. Karmides tingimustes elavad loomad on pidanud kohanema äärmuslike raskustega.

programme.title: Route 66. Ameerika kahel pool maanteed
programme.desc: Stiilsed teeäärsed motellid ei jää meist sammugi maha. Ühe sellise juures kohtume sama rada läbivaid kiirendussportlasi ja jõuame peale põgusat vestlust välja järgmisesse osariiki - Kansasesse. Seal satume aga kokku kinolinalt ja televiisorist tuttavaks saanud tegelastega. Oklahomasse jõudes maitseme kuulsat küpsist ja saame tootemisammastelt sõnumeid. Sekka ports kuulsusi, erineva oskuspagasiga muusikuid ja hiiglasi. Produtsent Herbert Murd, režissöör Väino Laisaar. Saatejuhid Madis Aesma, Laura Prits, Artur Aukon.

programme.title: Dünastiad
programme.desc: Lääne-Aafrikas Senegalis elab rühm šimpanse, keda on juba kolm aastat juhtinud alfaisane David. See on aeg, millal enamik juhte tõugatakse troonilt. Davidil ei ole ka liitlasi, kes aitaksid tal positsiooni kaitsta. Teda ümbritsevad rivaalid, kes ihkavad tema krooni ja on valmis selle nimel tapma.

programme.title: Dünastiad
programme.desc: Kui meri kinni külmub ja kõik teised Antarktise loomad on mandrilt lahkunud, tulevad Keiserpingviinid maismaale pesitsema. Nad peavad koostööd tegema, et nad ise ja nende pojad suudaksid karmi talve üle elada.

programme.title: Metsalood
programme.desc: Punakurk-kaur on väike ja ujeda loomuga nõtke lind, kes jahib kala tiikides. Looduses pesitseb ta väiksematel veekogudel, ent tibudele käib ta toitu jahtimas kaugel eemal suurtel järvedel.

programme.title: AK 70. Maailm Eesti silme läbi
programme.desc: "Aktuaalne kaamera" on edastanud Eesti inimestele uudiseid juba 70 aastat. Ajaga ei ole saate jõud raugenud. Pigem vastupidi - üha segasemas maailmas on uudisvoog kiirem, vaatajad nõudlikumad ja võimalused avaramad. Erisaates uurime, kuidas on Eesti vanim uudistesaade usaldusväärsust säilitanud, kes on püsivaataja ja millised on maailmahaardega toimetuse tulevikuambitsioonid? Saatejuht Maria-Ann Rohemäe, režissöör Sander Allikmäe, produtsent Rait Roland Veskemaa.

programme.title: Pealtnägija tähed
programme.desc: "Pealtnägija tähed" toob vaatajani saatesarja viimaste aastate säravaimad persoonid.

programme.title: Kurlingu segapaaride MM
programme.desc: Harri Lill ja Marie Kaldvee naasevad pärast veebruarikuist taliolümpiat suurele kurlinguareenile Šveitsis, kus peetakse segapaaride maailmameistrivõistlused. 2024. aasta hõbemedalivõitjad ja mulluse MM-i 4. koha omanikud Lill ja Kaldvee loodavad hooajale tugeva punkti panna.

programme.title: Sam ja Julia
programme.desc: Ella korraldab tüdrukute peo, Sam ja Julia aga nuputavad koos, kuidas Sam ka peole pääseks.

programme.title: Anna ja sõbrad
programme.desc: Sisene lihtsasse Anna ja sõprade maailma, milles on rõõmu ja entusiasmi, mida lapsepõlv toob. Sarjas "Anna ja sõbrad" on viis lahutamatut sõpra, kes tähistavad sõpruse võimet, kujutlusvõimelist mängu ja tagaaia seikluseid!

programme.title: Veel üks Lotte
programme.desc: 10-aastane Luise avastab suvelaagrisse saabudes, et seal on temaga äravahetamiseni sarnane tüdruk - Lotte. Esialgu ei taha tüdrukud teineteisega rääkidagi, kuid jutule saades taipavad nad õige pea, et on tegelikult kaksikud, kelle nende vanemad on imikueas lahutanud. Kuna Luise tahaks väga saada tuttavaks oma emaga, Lotte jällegi isaga, otsustavad tüdrukud pärast laagri lõppu omavahel kohad vahetada: Luise läheb elama Frankfurti, ajakirjanikust ema juurde, Lotte aga muusikust isa juurde Salzburgi. Esialgu ei taipa keegi midagi, ainult isa sõbra koer saab aru, et asi pole õige... See on läbi aastakümnete armastatud Erich Kästneri lasteraamatu uusim, nüüdisajastatud ekraniseering.

programme.title: Buratino tegutseb jälle
programme.desc: Buratino oleks napilt unustanud armsa Papa Carlo sünnipäeva! Tähtsad asjad ununevad meil seepärast, et pea on tühjast-tähjast pungil. Papa Carlo jutustab sõpradele loo rääkivast puuhalust. Näitlejad Priit Võigemast, Karol Kuntsel, Maria Soomets, Anti Reinthal, kaasa teevad Argo Aadli ja Indrek Sammul. Stsenarist Wimberg, toimetaja Margus Saar.

programme.title: Sandarm jääb pensionile
programme.desc: Prantsuse koomiku Louis de Funèsi Sandarmi-seeria neljandas filmis puhuvad sandarmeerias uued tuuled, sest vanad olijad saadetakse erru, et noorematele ruumi teha. Sandarm Cruchot' (de Funes) pensionipõli jääb aga üürikeseks, kui üks tema endine kolleeg õnnetuse tõttu mälu kaotab ning kunagine brigaad saab uuesti kokku, et aidata mehe mälestusi taastada. Tulemuseks on pöörane sündmustejada, mille käigus pööratakse kogu Saint-Tropez pea peale. R: Jean Girault. O: Louis de Funès, Michel Galabru jt.

programme.title: Spektaakel
programme.desc: Igal aastal kogunevad tuhanded Eesti venekeelsed elanikud Narva jõe äärde seda kontserti jälgima. Kontsert ülistab Nõukogude minevikku ja püüab emotsionaalselt siduda kohalikku venekeelset kogukonda Venemaaga. Dokumentaal uurib süvitsi Ivangorodis toimunud Eesti publikule suunatud kõnekontserti, mis paraku polnud sugugi neutraalne mälestusüritus - tegemist oli hoolikalt lavastatud vaenuliku psühholoogilise operatsiooniga. "Spektaakel" paljastab, kuidas 9. mai Ivangorodi kontserdi kaudu viib vaenulik Venemaa läbi sihitud provokatiivset rünnakut Eesti vastu. Ekspertide, sealhulgas Valgevenest põgenenud endiste jõustruktuuride operatiivtöötajate abil lammutame selle jabura, pompöösselt lavastatud nostalgiatralli tükkideks, paljastamaks Kremli pahatahtlikke mõjutusmeetodeid ja neid pahatahtlikke inimesi, kes seda "projekti" Venemaa poolelt korraldavad. Režissöör Ken Saan. Tootja Svetlana Filmid.

programme.title: Cannes. Lõikamata
programme.desc: 1946. aastal alustanud Cannesi filmifestival on kehtestanud end maailma juhtiva filmipeona, kuhu meelelahutusmaailma säravaimad superstaarid igal aastal kokku tulevad, et ennast näidata ja oma töid tutvustada. Sellest on saanud ka tähtis filmiturg ja moeüritus. Oma kogemusi seoses Cannesiga jagavad korraldajad, žüriiliikmed, näitlejad ja ajakirjanikud.

programme.title: Mäng
programme.desc: Kaasaegse tantsu särav koreograaf Alexander Ekman kutsuti lavastama Pariisi rahvusooperi tantsijatega. Suurejoonelisuse ja unenäoliste kujundite poolest tuntud Ekman täitis seekord Palais Garnier' lava metallkonstruktsioonidega, mille vahel tantsivad Mikael Karlssoni kaasahaarava muusika saatel erinevatel kõrgustel baleriinid.

programme.title: Veteranirock 2026
programme.desc: 23. aprillil tähistasime veteranipäeva. Unibet Arenal astusid suurejoonelisel kontserdil üles Vanilla Ninja koos sõjaväeorkestriga, 5MIINUST rock'n'roll bänd, Reket ja Laura Prits. Lisaks käisime Kuperjanovi jalaväepataljoniga metsas õppustel, uurisime, kuidas läheb meie kõige uuemal väejuhatusel, ja rääkisime veteranidega selle päeva tähtsusest. Saatejuht Andres Kuusk, režissöörid Keiti Väliste ja Sebastian Koljak. Juhtoperaator Andrus Rebane, produtsent Tiina-Mari Koljak.

programme.title: Salaopakad
programme.desc: Kas salapärane Kirsty, Clintoni telefonist leitud arvatav kontaktisik, võib just olla inimene, kes Domi ja Kay sellest jamast välja aitab? Nad lepivad Kirstyga kohtumise kokku ja asuvad uurima kahtlaselt käituvat prefekt Edwardsit, tungides tema kabinetti.

programme.title: ERR.ee uudised
programme.desc: Eesti Rahvusringhäälingu uudised - Eesti ja kogu maailma kõige värskemad uudised.

programme.title: Neli venda
programme.desc: Nelja noormehe kasuema lastakse poeröövi käigus maha ning nood asuvad ise juhtumit lahendama ja mõrtsukaid otsima. Kuid kõik ei olegi nii, nagu esialgu paistab.

programme.title: Paranormaalne aktiivsus: Varidimensioon
programme.desc: Perekond Fleege - isa Ryan (Chris J. Murray), ema Emily (Brit Shaw) ja nende väike tütar Leila (Ivy George) kolivad uude majja, mille garaažist tuleb lagedale kast vanade videokassettide ja -kaameraga. Vaadates majas ringi läbi selle vana kaamera silma, muutuvad ilmseks veidrad nähtused teispoolsusest. Üsna pea saab selgeks, et öine külaline varjuderiigist on eelkõige huvitatud pere noorimast liikmest ning vanemate jõupingutused oma last kaitsta leiavad võrdväärset vastupanu mustadelt jõududelt.

programme.desc: USA/ Suurbritannia 2015 märul Lavastaja:James McTeigue Osades:Milla Jovovich, Pierce Brosnan, Dylan McDermott Äsja Londonis asuvasse Ameerika Ühendriikide saatkonda lähetatud välisagendi (Milla Jovovich) ülesandeks on takistada terroristidel siseneda USA-ss. programme.title: Ohtlik aadress
programme.desc: Põnevik õnnelikust noorpaarist Chrisist ja Lisast, kes otsustasid kolida rahulikku elamupiirkonda Lakeview Terrace'is. Peagi hakkavad nad oma valikus kahtlema, sest nende uus naaber Albert osutub tüütuks ahistajaks. Albert on rassistist politsei, kellele ei meeldi uustulnukate rassidevaheline erinevus - nimelt on Chris heledanahaline ja Lisa tumedanahaline. Seega on ta otsustanud oma uute naabrite elu maapealseks põrguks muuta, ahistades neid igal vabal võimalusel, et sundida neid lahkuma.

programme.title: Vale pööre
programme.desc: Chris koos viie sõbraga jäävad pärast autoavariid tsivilisatsioonist kaugele metsa. Mida sügavamale metsa nad satuvad, seda lähemale tuleb neile verdtarretav saatus.

programme.title: Halloween
programme.desc: John Carpenteri kultusliku õudusfilmi uusversioon. Pärast pikki psühhiaatriahaiglas veedetud aastaid naaseb Michael Myers täpselt Halloweeni ajal kodulinna.

programme.title: Võmmipesa
programme.desc: USA 1997 krimidraama Lavastaja: James Mangold Osades: Sylvester Stallone, Michael Rappaport, Harvey Keitel, Ray Liotta, Robert De Niro, Peter Berg 1280 elanikuga Carrisoni nimeline väikelinnake on eriline. Selle elanikud on kõik politseinikud koos oma peredega, kes siin väljateenitud rahu naudivad. Kuid mustad ärid ei ole jätnud ka seda kohta puutumata, sest linnakest finantseerib maffia. Kui noor politseinik Murray Babitch (Michael Rappaport) kaks relvastamat mustanahalist maha laseb, ilmub kohale sisejuurdluse agent Moe Tilden (Robert DeNiro). Ta peab rinda pistma poolkurdi hädavaresest ðerif Garrison Freddy Hefliniga (Sylvester Stallone), kes näeb esimest korda võimalust kaotaja rollist loobuda, kuid tunneb ka lojaalsust kaaselanike ja nende juhi Ray Donlani vastu (Harvey Keitel).

programme.title: Surmanuhtlus
programme.desc: Täiusliku eluga juhtivtöötaja näeb pealt midagi, mis muudab tema elu igaveseks. Leinast muserdatuna tuleb ta hirmutavale järeldusele, et oma pere kaistmisel on kõik võtted lubatud.

programme.title: Cadillac Records
programme.desc: Plaadifirma Chess Recordsi ja tema artistide kuulsaks saamise lugu.

programme.title: Nõiutud kuningriik 3D
programme.desc: Lummav teekond läbi looduse nõidusliku maagia.

programme.title: Väike merineitsi
programme.desc: Kuri nõid kasutab ära näkineiu naiivsust ja röövib ta hinge. Päästa võiks neiu vaid tõeline armastus, mida ta kohtab noore muinasjutuvestja näol.

programme.title: Suurepärased väitlejad (2007)
programme.desc: Tõestisündinud lugu professor Melvin B. Tolsonist, kes inspireeris õpilasi moodustama oma kooli esimest väitlusmeeskonda ja esitama USA riiklikul väitlusturniiril väljakutse Harvardi Ülikoolile.

programme.title: A.I. - tehisintellekt
programme.desc: Inimkond on loonud robotid, kes suudavad tunda tundeid, kuid ei ole võtnud vaevaks õpetada neid oma emotsioonidega toime tulema. Laps-robot püüab oma niinimetatud ema armastust tagasi võita.

programme.title: Poiss triibulises pidzaamas
programme.desc: Brunol on uues kodus igav ja ta kolab ringi ümberkaudsetes metsades. Ta leiab kummalise aia, mille taga on mustvalgesse pidžaamasse riietatud poiss. Alguse saab ootamatu sõprus.

programme.title: Vabaliikumises
programme.desc: Suurlinnas elav teismeline Ren MacCormac kolib väikelinna, kus on keelustatud rockmuusika ja tantsimine. Nooruki mässumeelne vastuhakk raputab kohalikke.

programme.title: Liblikmehe ettekuulutus
programme.desc: Kaks aastat pärast oma naise traagilist surma satub ajakirjanik ameerika väikelinna, kus toimuvad seletamatud sündmused.

programme.title: Justin Bieber: Ära iial ütle iial
programme.desc: Dokumentaalfilm jälgib Justin Bieberit ja näitab kaadreid tema esinemistelt 2010. aasta turneel.

programme.title: Näljamängud: Pilapasknäär - Osa 2
programme.desc: Ulmesaaga Katniss Everdeeni võitlusest Kapitooliumi diktatuuri ja president Snow vastu jõuab dünaamilisse ja pingelisse finaali.

programme.title: Tänavajurist
programme.desc: USA 2011 draamaLavastaja: Brad FurmanOsades: Matthew McConaughey, Marisa Tomei, Ryan PhillippeMickey Haller (Matthew McConaughey) on edukas advokaat, kes enamjaolt tegeleb tööasjadega L.A.'s ringi sõites, tema kontoriks on luksusauto ning enamus tema kliente on silmnähtavalt süüdi olevad narkoärikad ja gängsterid, kellest enamus on ta ka trellidest päästnud. Kuid ühel hetkel pakutakse talle tööd kaitsta Louis Rouleti (Ryan Phillippe), rikkast kinnisvaramaaklerit, keda süüdistatakse ühe neiu mõrvakatses ja väärkohtlemises. Louis seda süüdistust omaks loomulikult ei võta ning samuti usub ka Mickey tema süütusesse, kuniks päevavalgele hakkavad tulema nii mõnedki faktid, mis hakkavad tõsiselt häirima Mickey kohtuasja lahendamise strateegiat ja ka tema usku Louis'i süütusesse.

programme.title: Hollywoodland
programme.desc: "Hollywoodland" põhineb tõestisündinud lool, käsitledes Hollywoodi kurikuulsaimat lahendamata mõistatust ja viib vaataja keset 1950ndate aastate Los Angelese glamuuri, skandaale ja korruptsiooni. Kui telesaate "Supermani seiklused" staar George Reeves (Ben Affleck) leitakse oma kodust surnuna, on miljonid fännid ta surma asjaoludest šokeeritud. Politsei ja stuudiobossid soovivad, et juhtum lõpetaks enesetapuna, kuid kuulujutud ei kao. Eradetektiiv Louis Simo (Adrien Brody) võtab jälje üles ja hakkab kildudest kokku panema näitleja viimaseid, pingetest tulvil päevi. Kes vajutas päästikule? Kas see oli võrgutav, ent intriige punuv kihlatu, mahajäetud armuke (Diane Lane), raevunud abikaasa (Bob Hoskins) või hoopis Reeves ise?

programme.title: Ali
programme.desc: Kaheosaline film spordilegend Muhammad Alist, mis kajastab tema elu ajavahemikus 1964 kuni legendaarse Rumble in the Jungle'ini 1974. aastal.

programme.title: Kodus ja võõrsil
programme.desc: Fenomenaalselt edukas ja pikaealine Austraalia draamasari ookeani-äärse väikelinna Summer Bay elanike rõõmudest ja muredest, armumistest ja südamete purunemistest. Sarja trumbiks on haaravad ja inimlikult usutavad tegelaskujud, kelle eludega on vaatajal kerge samastuda. Tegelaste galerii on ka piisavalt mitmekesine, et igaüks leiaks endale lemmiku, kellele kaasa elada - siin on nii teismelisi, noori täiskasvanuid kui ka juba küpsesse keskikka jõudnud peategelasi. Lisaboonuseks on Summer Bay igikestev päikesepaiste, mis rõhutab sarja positiivsust ja elurõõmu.

programme.title: Kellele kuulub su süda?
programme.desc: Ella ja Georgi vahel valitseb teatud lähedus, kuid Isa ei taha kummalegi andestada. Chris aitab Ellal vastu pidada ja nende suhted on peagi nagu headel aegadel. Kahjuks ei pane nad tähele, et armukade Linda peab neid silmas ja sepitseb plaane Chrisi tagasi saamiseks.

programme.title: Reporter
programme.desc: Uudistemagasinide lipulaev, mis toob olulisemad ja põnevamad uudised kodumaalt ja mujalt maailmast vaatajateni Reporterile omasel mahlakal moel. Saatejuhid on alati soliidsed Jaanus Koort, Simon Suviste ja Tõnis Sarap.

programme.title: Rosamunde Pilcher: Maagiline buss
programme.desc: Olivia võtab oma julguse kokku, lahkub kindlast töökohast ja asutab oma reisifirma. Ta tahab hakata korraldama elitaarseid reise väikestele gruppidele. Esimesel reisil veab aga kõik viltu: esmalt jääb ta ilma kinnipandud hotellitubadest, siis kaob üks turistidest lausa kummalisel kombel.

programme.title: Kidzone lastehommik _ Käpapatrull
programme.desc: Käpa-Patrull on eelkooliealiste sari, peaosas grupp kangelaslikke kutsikaid: Chase, Marshall, Rocky, Zuma, Rubble ja Skye, keda juhib 10-aastane tehnikataibuga poiss Ryder. Olles unikaalne segu probleemide lahendamise oskustest, ägedatest sõidukitest ja armsast rohkest kutsahuumorist, teeb Käpa-Patrull koostööd ülitähtsatel päästeoperatsioonidel, et kaitsta Seiklustelahe kogukonda. Tuletõrjekoer Marshallist politseikoer Chase'ini, ja Skye'ni, kes lendab kõrgelt oma helikopteriga, näitavad nad tiimitöö ja hea kodakondsuse tähtsust. Neil kõigil on seljas omaenda eriline Kutsakott, mis aitab neil kõigega toime tulla - kassipoegade aitamisest rongi päästmiseni kalju äärelt! Ja pole vahet kui suur on seiklus, Käpa-Patrullil on alati aega mänguks, naeruks ja üheks kõrvasügamiseks Ryderilt. Lõbus Käpa-Patrulli fakt: Ryder päästis kõik need kutsad ja õpetas neile nende Käpa-Patrulli oskused.

programme.title: Kidzone lastehommik _ Alvin ja koopaoravad
programme.desc: Käsna-Kalle Kantpüks on animafilmisari, mille peaosas on kollane merikäsn Käsna-Kalle, kes elab ookeanisügavustes veealuses linnas, mille nimi on Bikiini Põhi. Koos oma sõbra, roosa meritähe Patrickuga, satub ta kõige hullumeelsematesse ja põnevamatesse seiklustesse. Käsna-Kallel on väga energiline ja optimistlik iseloom, ning ta töötab kokana restoranis Krõbe Krabi, kus valmistab merepõhja parimaid burgereid.

programme.title: Kidzone lastehommik _ Alvin ja koopaoravad
programme.desc: Käsna-Kalle Kantpüks on animafilmisari, mille peaosas on kollane merikäsn Käsna-Kalle, kes elab ookeanisügavustes veealuses linnas, mille nimi on Bikiini Põhi. programme.desc: Käsna-Kalle Kantpüks on animafilmisari, mille peaosas on kollane merikäsn Käsna-Kalle, kes elab ookeanisügavustes veealuses linnas, mille nimi on Bikiini Põhi. programme.desc: Käsna-Kalle Kantpüks on animafilmisari, mille peaosas on kollane merikäsn Käsna-Kalle, kes elab ookeanisügavustes veealuses linnas, mille nimi on Bikiini Põhi.
